neighbours.label: ' even' as an escalating intensifier ('X and even Y')
fire: Regular exercise can ease and even prevent back pain.
The storm damaged roofs and even toppled a few trees.
Some fans waited hours, and a few even camped overnight.
The new drug may slow or even reverse the disease.
She speaks French, German and even a little Japanese.
Prices doubled and in some towns even tripled.
The puppy chewed shoes, cables and even the sofa.
Good sleep can improve and even transform your mood.
quiet: Regular exercise can ease back pain for many people.
The storm damaged roofs across the whole county.
Some fans waited hours outside the stadium gates.
The new drug may slow the disease in older patients.
She speaks French and German fluently.
Prices doubled in most towns last year.
The puppy chewed shoes and cables.
Good sleep can improve your mood.

notes: Card: ' even' x3 ('reduce and even eliminate'); output direction of the + pole promotes completely/even/entirely. Probe: 'and even eliminate' 0.57; other card contexts scored under 0.05.
